contact: Use case: sketch-to-render. IMAGE 1 IS THE PRIMARY POSE TARGET. Replace the stick figure in image 1 with a fully rendered Lumine wearing the costume from image 2. Follow the pose of image 1 EXACTLY, especially BOTH legs. IMAGE 2 provides identity, normal head/body proportions, white blue gold clothing, flower, face and sword only; DO NOT copy its standing legs. The finished character's NEAR leg starts at the left hip and crosses IN FRONT toward the right knee/forward right boot. The FAR leg starts at the right hip and goes BEHIND toward the left knee/back left toe. This visible X crossing of thighs is REQUIRED, the image is unusable without it. The whole body faces right at 3/4 view as the style reference, relaxed sword hand carrying sword angled forward-down, whole sword in canvas. Render in same polished flat-shaded illustration style as image 2. Normal head size, long natural legs, no chibi. Transparent background with no colored guide lines, no text, no ground or shadows. ONE 1024x1536 portrait full-body pose; hair top y107, ground y1435.
passing: Use case: sketch-to-render. Image 1 is the PRIMARY POSE TARGET. Replace this stick-figure pose with Lumine as depicted by image 2, which supplies identity, normal head/body ratio, costume, flower and low carried sword. Follow image 1 legs EXACTLY rather than copying image 2 stance. The NEAR leg attached to viewer-LEFT hip beneath sword hand is the straight weight-bearing leg IN FRONT, foot flat on floor under pelvis. The FAR leg attached to viewer-RIGHT hip bends at knee toward right, with calf folded back LEFT BEHIND the planted near leg and boot entirely off ground. Thus the planted leg crosses IN FRONT of the bent swinging leg. Do not put the viewer-left thigh swinging back; left-hip thigh is bearing weight and right-hip thigh is swinging. Normal calm walking passing pose, knee bent about 35 degrees, not running or tiptoeing. Both boots point right. Keep same torso, head size, 3/4 view facing RIGHT, waist, sword and natural young proportions from image 2. Transparent background; no guide colors, no lines, text, shadows or particles. Single full unclipped character on 1024x1536 canvas with margin; head top around y107 and planted boot sole y1435.
